sync.title: Sync to other stores
sync.sourceEmpty: The source store has no categories, so there is nothing to sync.
sync.scopeCategoriesHint: Names, colours and order. Special products in the target stores are not changed.
sync.scopeProductsHint: Also marks the products as special and puts them into the matching categories
sync.noTargets: There are no other stores to sync to.
sync.modeLabel: What to do with existing content in target stores
sync.modeMergeHint: Categories with the same name are merged. The target store's own categories and special products are kept.
sync.modeReplaceHintCategories: Extra categories in the target store are deleted (their products become uncategorised).
sync.modeReplaceHintProducts: Extra categories in the target store are deleted and extra special products are unmarked.
sync.previewFailed: Could not preview. Please try again.
sync.previewInfo: Nothing has been written yet. Target stores are only updated after you confirm, and registers pick it up on their next refresh.
sync.previewMarkWarning: Once marked as special, these products stop following the warehouse's price changes in that store, exactly as when marked by hand.
sync.replaceTitle: Replace deletes content in the target stores
sync.replaceSummaryCategories: {{removed}} extra categories in the target stores will be deleted (their products become uncategorised).
sync.replaceSummaryProducts: {{removed}} extra categories will be deleted and {{unmarked}} extra special products will be unmarked.
sync.replaceNothing: The target stores have nothing extra, so replacing deletes nothing.
sync.replaceConfirm: I understand these changes cannot be undone automatically
sync.replaceAlertBody: {{removed}} categories will be deleted and {{unmarked}} special products unmarked. This cannot be undone automatically.
sync.skippedLine: {{count}} products will be skipped (the store does not have them or they have no retail price)

sync.resultFailedCount: {{count}} stores failed (nothing was written to them)
sync.resultReplaced: Deleted {{removed}} categories and unmarked {{unmarked}} special products
sync.resultLogHint: This sync was recorded in the operation log (who, when, which stores, and the counts). Each store can be adjusted afterwards without affecting the others.
